date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its publication; it says the agencies recently discovered the intrusion.
title: CIA and two other US agencies reportedly hit by intrusion exposing unclassified information, NYT reported
org: Central Intelligence Agency; National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency; Office of the Director of National Intelligence
summary: Sada Elbalad, relaying a New York Times report, says the CIA and at least two other agencies recently discovered an intrusion that exposed some unclassified information. The agencies named are the CIA, the NGA and the ODNI; the report says an open-source intelligence analysis system was hit and classified material was not at risk. Two sources told the Times early indicators point to China; investigators do not yet know who is responsible.
plain: A report relayed from the New York Times says the CIA and two other US agencies had some unclassified information exposed in an intrusion. Sources say classified material was not at risk and early indicators point to China.
exec: US intelligence agencies reportedly had unclassified data exposed; the report says classified material was not at risk and the cause is not established.
